en.askTitle: Put in your own dates, airports and budget to get an Istanbul plan where every price is checked or clearly marked as an estimate
en.runTitle: Germany to Istanbul: four first-timer days for two on about EUR 1,400

fields.label: Travellers and dates
fields.value: A couple from Germany; arrive Thu 23 Sep 2027, leave Mon 27 Sep 2027

fields.label: Budget and currency
fields.value: About EUR 1,400 for two, excluding flights

fields.label: Walking and access needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. no steps-heavy routes, a rest each afternoon

fields.label: Hotel preferences
fields.placeholder: e.g. quiet room, close to a tram stop

fields.label: Must-see places
fields.value: The big historic sights in Sultanahmet, a public Bosphorus ferry, Kadıköy, food markets and street food, and one hammam

en.template: Plan an Istanbul trip for {when}, arriving at {arrive} and leaving from {depart}, with {budget}, {access}, {hotel} and {places}. Keep evenings relaxed, separate quotes from allowances, check ordinary ferries in both directions and leave alternatives for uncertain prices or services. Do not book or contact anyone.

phases.title: Check sight prices, opening hours, hotels and airport transport from current sources
phases.note: Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Topkapı, the Basilica Cistern and a hammam
phases.judgment: It noticed that older and newer sources disagree on the Basilica Cistern’s hours: a newer operator notice sets 09:00–19:00 from 15 November 2026, so the older evening sessions were not relied on, and the new ticket price is marked as unconfirmed.

phases.title: Build the itinerary and a dated source list
phases.note: Transit times, fares, entry rules and a scam-awareness note
phases.judgment: Its fare check corrected a number: the city’s base transit fare is ₺46.20 from 20 July 2026, not ₺42, confirmed from the official transport operator’s own notice. It kept the fares it could not confirm, such as Marmaray and the metro line to the airport, listed as open gaps.

phases.title: Check the budget sums, dates and delivered files
phases.judgment: The final answer shows a checked €1,400 budget and names what is still unknown: September hotel quotes, the Cistern’s new ticket price, exact Sunday ferry connections and some rail and metro fares. Estimates are kept apart from verified figures.

workers: Checked official prices, opening hours and queue tips for the main sights, and one hammam’s price
Checked official fares for the Istanbulkart, trams, ferries and airport transfers, and the entry rules for German passport holders

zh.askTitle: 填上你自己的日期、机场和预算，得到一份每个价格都核对过、或明确标为估算的伊斯坦布尔行程
zh.runTitle: 德国出发：两人首次游伊斯坦布尔四天，预算约 1,400 欧元

fields.label: 人数和日期
fields.value: 来自德国的一对夫妻，2027 年 9 月 23 日（周四）抵达，9 月 27 日（周一）离开

fields.label: 抵达机场及时间
fields.placeholder: 例如：伊斯坦布尔机场（IST），14:30 落地

fields.label: 离境机场及时间
fields.placeholder: 例如：萨比哈·格克琴机场（SAW），18:00 起飞

fields.label: 预算及币种
fields.value: 两人约 1,400 欧元，不含机票

fields.label: 步行和通行需要
fields.placeholder: 例如：避开台阶多的路线，每天下午要休息

fields.label: 酒店偏好
fields.placeholder: 例如：房间安静，离电车站近

fields.label: 最想看的地方
fields.value: 苏丹艾哈迈德区的主要古迹、一次公共博斯普鲁斯渡轮、卡德柯伊、美食市场和街头小吃，以及一次土耳其浴

zh.template: 请按{when}、{arrive}、{depart}、{budget}、{access}、{hotel}以及{places}，帮我安排伊斯坦布尔行程。晚上轻松一点，分清实价和预留，查普通渡轮双向衔接，遇到价格或服务不确定时给出备选。不要预订，也不要联系任何人。

phases.title: 用最新来源核对景点价格、开放时间、酒店和机场交通
phases.note: 圣索菲亚、蓝色清真寺、托普卡帕宫、地下水宫殿和土耳其浴
phases.judgment: 它发现新旧来源对地下水宫殿的开放时间说法不一：较新的运营方通知从 2026 年 11 月 15 日起改为 09:00–19:00，所以没有采用旧的夜场信息，新的门票价格也标明尚未确认。

phases.title: 做出行程和带日期的来源清单
phases.note: 换乘时间、票价、入境规定和防骗提示
phases.judgment: 查票价时纠正了一个数字：市内公交基础票价自 2026 年 7 月 20 日起是 46.20 里拉，不是 42 里拉，依据是官方交通运营方自己的通知。没能确认的票价，如马尔马拉铁路和机场地铁线，则列为尚未核实。

phases.title: 检查预算加总、日期和交付文件
phases.judgment: 终稿给出一份核对过的 1,400 欧元预算，并写明仍不确定的部分：9 月的酒店报价、地下水宫殿新票价、周日渡轮的确切衔接，以及部分轨道和地铁票价。估算和已核实的数字分开标注。

workers: 核对主要景点的官方价格、开放时间和排队建议，以及一家土耳其浴的价格
核对伊斯坦布尔卡、电车、渡轮和机场接驳的官方票价，以及德国护照持有人的入境规定
